# US launch: exact bios and first 9 posts (copy-paste)

Date: 2026-09-25. Companion to `01-brand-presentation.md` (India-oriented) and `11-us-diaspora-and-mainstream-playbook.md`.
US English spelling throughout. Replace every `{PLACEHOLDER}` before posting.

## Honesty rules for every line below (do not edit these away)
- Stock for the first US container lands about **18 Jan 2027**; until then we sell **made-to-order and take waitlist/quote requests only**.
  Never write "in stock", "ships in 3-7 days" or "free shipping" before it is true.
- Say **"mango wood"/"acacia wood"** only for pieces really made of it; use "solid wood" only if the piece is solid (not MDF/plywood).
  No "teak", "rosewood" or "sheesham" claim until the owner confirms species and the written CITES stance. If sheesham: "sheesham (Indian rosewood)".
- No fake reviews, no invented counts ("100+ happy homes"), no "30% cheaper". Use real footage of the real workshop only.
- Made-to-order lead time: say "**about 10-12 weeks; we confirm your date before you pay**" (FTC ship-date rule, see `docs/countries/us-legal-requirements.md`).
- Confirm carpenters have consented to appear on camera (no minors in shots).

**About (long):**
```
The Wood Vintage is a family of carpenters in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India, making hand-carved wood furniture, mandirs (pooja units), mirrors and décor.

We build every piece in our own workshop, and we build it to your size and finish. Tell us about your space, send a photo or a rough sketch, and we'll send a design and a written quote.

How it works: 1) Tell us what you need  2) We send a design and quote  3) You approve and pay a deposit  4) We build it and share progress photos  5) We ship it to you.

Made to order lead time is about 10-12 weeks; we confirm your date before you pay.

We're preparing our first shipment to the USA. Join the waitlist or message us for a quote.
```

## 3. First 9 posts (post over the first 2 weeks; 3 reels + 3 carousels + 3 static/stories-backed)
Format: **Type** | shot list | caption | hashtags (max 5) | CTA | alt text. Post one per day at your best time; comments answered within 1 hour on days 1-7.

### Post 1: Reel, "Welcome to our workshop" (pin)
- **Shots (15-20 s):** wide shot of the workshop; hands sanding wood; chisel carving; a carpenter smiling to camera; final piece with the logo card.
- **On-screen text:** "Made by our carpenters. Jodhpur, India."
- **Caption:**
```
This is where every Wood Vintage piece begins: our own workshop in Jodhpur, India.

No factory line. No stock photos. Just carpenters, wood, and time.

We hand-carve wooden furniture and mandirs, and we build to your size and finish. We're getting ready to ship to the USA.

Follow along to watch each piece come to life. 🪵
```
- **Hashtags:** `#handcarved #woodfurniture #jodhpur #madeinindia #artisanmade`
- **CTA:** "Want a piece for your home? Tap the link in bio for a free quote."
- **Alt text:** Carpenters working on a hand-carved wooden piece in a Jodhpur workshop.

### Post 2: Carousel (5 slides), "Meet the makers"
- **Slides:** 1) portrait of the head carpenter + name, 2) his tools, 3) what he makes best, 4) years of experience (ONLY real number), 5) "Say hi in the comments".
- **Caption:**
```
Meet {NAME}. He has been carving wood for {N} years, and he leads the team that will build your piece.

Every carving you see here is done by hand, not by machine. Swipe to see his tools and what he loves to make.

Say hi to {NAME} in the comments 👋
```
- **Hashtags:** `#meetthemaker #artisan #handcarved #jodhpur #woodcarving`
- **CTA:** "Questions for our carpenters? Ask below."
- **Needs:** written consent from the person shown.

### Post 3: Carousel (6 slides), "What is your furniture made of?"
- **Slides:** 1) title "Wood, explained", 2) `{WOOD_1}` (e.g. mango wood): look, strength, care, 3) `{WOOD_2}`, 4) how to tell solid wood from MDF/plywood (cross-section photo), 5) why we use solid wood, 6) "Ask us before you buy anything, from anyone."
- **Caption:**
```
Not all "wood" furniture is solid wood. Some is MDF or plywood with a thin wood look on top.

Here's how to tell the difference, and which woods we use and why. Save this for your next furniture shopping trip. 📌

Always ask the seller what a piece is made of. We'll always tell you.
```
- **Hashtags:** `#solidwood #woodfurniture #furnitureguide #homedecor #handmade`
- **CTA:** "Tell us which piece you're planning and we'll suggest the right wood."
- **Rule:** name only woods you actually use; no comparison naming competitors.

### Post 4: Reel, "How a carved mandir is made" (process)
- **Shots (20-30 s):** rough timber -> outline -> carving close-ups -> assembly -> finishing -> finished mandir beside a doorway for scale.
- **On-screen text:** "Rough wood to finished mandir" + timestamps ("Week 1: carving", "Week 3: finishing").
- **Caption:**
```
Watch a carved mandir take shape, from a rough block of wood to a finished pooja unit.

Every jaali and every carving is done by hand, one cut at a time. That's why each piece takes weeks, not days.

Would you like one in your home? We build to your wall size. 🪔
```
- **Hashtags:** `#mandir #poojaroom #handcarved #indianhome #homedecor`
- **CTA:** "Send us your wall size for a free design quote."
- **Alt text:** Time-lapse of a wooden mandir being carved and finished by hand.

### Post 5: Carousel (6 slides), "How custom works" (pin)
- **Slides:** 1) title "Made to your space", 2) Step 1 Tell us (photo, size, style), 3) Step 2 We design and quote, 4) Step 3 You approve + deposit, 5) Step 4 We build and send progress photos, 6) Step 5 We ship it; "about 10-12 weeks, date confirmed before you pay".

- **Slides:** 1) title, 2) keep away from heat/direct sun, 3) wipe with a dry/damp soft cloth, 4) use coasters/felt pads, 5) re-oil once or twice a year (only the method you really recommend).

```
Save this so you have it when your piece arrives.
```
- **Hashtags:** `#woodcare #furniturecare #homecare #solidwood #homedecor`

## 8. Before you post (30-minute checklist)
- [ ] Real WhatsApp business number set; `{PLACEHOLDERS}` replaced; email address created.
- [ ] Carpenter consent and no-minors check for every clip.
- [ ] Wood names/claims in captions match what is really used (owner confirms species).
- [ ] Music: use royalty-free/library audio or Instagram's business-safe audio only.
- [ ] Waitlist form states how data is used; unsubscribe/consent wording ready (`docs/countries/us-legal-requirements.md`).
- [ ] Post 8 labeled "Design concept"; no real-order claims until real orders exist.
- [ ] UTM links tested; `/us` landing page exists or bio link points to a working quote form.
- [ ] Set Instagram/Facebook profile language and time zone; schedule posts for US evenings (roughly 6-9 pm ET) and check Insights weekly.
